issues.title: Worker health status shows outage even though it's running
Users with view-only permissions cannot use workflows
Body from Notes are not well shared from one step to another
ID column visibility and order are reset in table widgets for junction objects without a Name field
Record page layout editor: the side panel header goes blank after renaming a Fields widget group
[Functional Regression] Missing menu icon and direct item creation on custom object sections in record detail views
Workspace AI instructions (`aiAdditionalInstructions`) are never sent to MCP clients
AI agent record search throws on LLM-generated filters (ilike on RICH_TEXT / operator at object level)

discussions.title: Show the object icon in global search results

latest_release.body:
<!-- generated-release-notes v1 -->

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Drop the legacy workspace workflow object ([#30036](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30036)) by @charlesBochet
- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Read row level permission rules in the permission compiler ([#30132](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30132)) by @charlesBochet
- [BREAKING_CHANGE] Mask record grants with limiting roles and drop legacy current user permissions ([#30145](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30145)) by @charlesBochet
- chore(security): bump exa-js to 2.28.0 in the exa app ([#30188](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30188)) by @mabdullahabaid

## ✨ New features

- feat(getting-started): show Keep Twenty in the sidebar card and drop the trial days bar ([#30056](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30056)) by @etiennejouan
- feat(getting-started): add a Next button to the step header ([#30065](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30065)) by @etiennejouan
- feat(getting-started): replace snooze options with a single snooze until tomorrow ([#30084](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/30084)) by @etiennejouan

## 💅 Improvements & UX

- Agents design fixes ([#29288](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29288)) by @Bonapara
- Remove the legacy CODE step logic-function path (2.57) ([#29620](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29620)) by @FelixMalfait
- Show the workspace and app logo when connecting OAuth apps ([#29640](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29640)) by @Bonapara
- Add an MCP tool workflow step backed by the cached server tools ([#29668](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29668)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- Notify members mentioned in app and workflow inbox messages ([#29675](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29675)) by @bosiraphael
- Let logic functions call the server through a private URL ([#29687](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29687)) by @prastoin
- Fix retried first send of a new inbox chat ([#29688](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29688)) by @bosiraphael
- Let validation rules read a record's previous values ([#29718](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29718)) by @FelixMalfait
- Add self-service two-factor authentication backup codes ([#29833](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29833)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- Show grouped table and list views as tabs, behind a feature flag ([#29855](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29855)) by @FelixMalfait
- Add DESIGN.md with Twenty's product UI rules ([#29861](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29861)) by @Bonapara
- Complete assistant identity presentation ([#29863](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29863)) by @bosiraphael
- Import email attachments as remote files streamed from the provider ([#29941](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29941)) by @neo773
- Evaluate RLS rules through a relation ([#29953](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29953)) by @charlesBochet
- Keep blank lines and br tags when converting markdown to rich text ([#29956](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29956)) by @BOHEUS
- Let messaging providers declare a chat or email conversation style ([#29963](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29963)) by @martmull
- Run applications with their grant ([#29965](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29965)) by @prastoin
- Validate HTTP tool requests and log their caller and outcome ([#29978](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29978)) by @prastoin
- Let a member session follow and stop its own ai.generate runs ([#29981](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29981)) by @FelixMalfait
- Let applications archive the inbox threads they wrote ([#29982](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29982)) by @FelixMalfait
- Batch attach_conversation_to_record into attach_conversation_to_records ([#29984](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/29984)) by @FelixMalfait
